BuildFlag.Title: Don't build .NET Core
BuildFlag.Description: Tick this if you don't want to build any projects that use .NET Core target framework. If you don't need .NET Core projects, this will reduce build times.

BuildFlag.Title: Don't build CargoWise Web
BuildFlag.Description: Tick this if you don't want to build any projects specific to CargoWise Web (Winzor framework). If you don't need CargoWise Web projects, this will reduce build times.

BuildFlag.Title: Disable Resource Strings
BuildFlag.Description: Tick this if you don't want to generate resource strings. If you only use CargoWise in English, then you should not need them in your local build. Disabling them will reduce build times.

BuildFlag.Title: Enable Roslyn Analyzers during build
BuildFlag.Description: Tick this to run the Roslyn analyzers during the build. This will slow down the build but might save you a rejected DAT submission due to analyzer failure.
